column1: # Known incompatibilities between reference stacks. Columns, separated by tabs:
# client, server, case, reason, waiver id, scope (role@adapter: the stack at
# fault), evidence URL (an upstream issue or PR, or a permalink to the lines of
# that stack at its pinned revision, versions.yaml).
# A listed case that fails is recorded "known" and does not fail the self-test;
# one that passes fails it: the entry is stale and must be removed. Each reason is in
# docs/CAPABILITIES.md (quirks by adapter). Each is the fault of a reference
# stack (scope); the pairings with "otfabric" run only with the own image
